viva-pinata game sourced

Viva Piñata

A garden sim in which the player shapes terrain, plants, and water to attract 60 piñata species, then meets each species' requirements to make them residents, breed them, and manage the predators among them.

2006RareEcosystem / evolutioncluster c059 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

dig, plant, and water the garden -> species outlines appear when appear requirements are met -> resident requirements turn visitors into residents -> residents meet romance requirements and lay eggs -> predators and sours disrupt -> sell or trade piñatas -> attract new species

design notes

Viva Piñata turns habitat suitability into a readable checklist: each species has staged appear, visit, resident, and romance requirements, shown as a black-and-white outline that fills in when residency is met. Because piñatavores must eat other piñatas to become residents or breed, attracting one species can consume another, so the garden is a hand-built food web the player tunes by fencing, spacing, and timing. Sours and Professor Pester's ruffians supply authored pressure, and romance requirements can be bypassed with candy once a species has bred, trading early difficulty for collection speed.

relations

9 stored edges
uses

Animal husbandry

Two residents of a species that meet romance requirements perform a romance dance and a maze minigame that yields an egg; piñatas are ungendered, and candy skips romance requirements after a species' first romance.

core
uses

Collection goals

The journal of 60 species, each with requirements to discover, is the long-term goal structure.

core
uses

Food web

Piñatavores must eat other piñatas to become residents or breed, and visiting predators eat residents to meet their own requirements.

core
uses

Habitat suitability

Each of the 60 species has staged requirements (garden contents, plants, water, terrain, or having eaten a specific item) that turn an outline into a visitor and then a resident.

core
uses

Asynchronous shared regions

Eggs and piñatas could be sent to other players over Xbox Live.

supporting
uses

Crop cultivation

Seeds sown with tools grow into flowers, vegetables, and trees that species eat or require; weeds spread and destroy vegetable rows if not removed.
